thread:
Zane: Hey team — addressed the requested changes in PR #4821. PTAL when you have a minute. Short summary: switched to prefix cache guard, added a small shim for legacy clients, updated unit + e2e tests, and left a changelog note. Patch snippet:
```diff
- response.format = "v2"
+ response.format = "v1_compat"
```
Sara: Thanks — quick Q: does this still return the old error codes that some legacy clients rely on? If not, can we add a thin shim that preserves the code mapping?
Zane: Yes — added runtime/compat/legacy_shim.go. It maps legacy error codes to the new format and preserves the old status for clients that set `Accept: legacy`. PTAL at the last commit (squash coming).
Alex: Left one tiny inline comment about using `log.Debugf` vs `log.Infof` for the shim. Otherwise looks good to me. Can you squash the fix and re-push?
Zane: Squashed + pushed fix for the logging level. CI should re-run shortly.
CI Bot: CI passed on branch main-4821 (linux/unit/e2e). All checks green.
Sara: LGTM :thumbsup: I'll merge during the next merge window unless Alex wants to re-check now.
Alex: I can re-check now; just want to confirm the changelog note is present. If it's there and CI stays green, I'll give a 👍 and you can merge.
Zane: Added the docs note at docs/compat.md and a short entry in CHANGELOG.md. Thanks everyone — ping me if anything else pops up.
